echoParts: But the fruit of the Spirit
verseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.
meaning: When the Holy Spirit lives inside us, he grows good things in our lives, just like a fruit tree grows delicious fruit.
